figure_inventory.description: Option (i): three overlapping ellipses in a horizontal chain, left to right: a sky-blue ellipse, a yellow ellipse and a green ellipse. The blue and yellow ellipses overlap (overlap lens shown light green); the yellow and green ellipses overlap (overlap lens shown darker green); the blue and green ellipses do NOT overlap each other. Labels under the diagram with dashed arrows: 'Multiples of 4' points to the blue ellipse (left), 'Multiples of 8' points (arrow starting inside the yellow ellipse, near its top centre, going straight down) to the yellow ellipse (centre), 'Multiples of 32' points to the green ellipse (right). Label '(i)' at the top left.

Option (ii): two overlapping ellipses of similar size: a sky-blue ellipse on the left and a yellow ellipse on the right, with a light-green lens where they overlap. Three labels with dashed arrows: 'Multiples of 4' points to the blue ellipse (arrow from its bottom-left), 'Multiples of 32' points to the yellow ellipse (arrow from its bottom-right), and 'Multiples of 8' is the middle label whose dashed arrow starts INSIDE the overlap lens and goes straight down, so the overlap region is labelled multiples of 8. Label '(ii)' at the top left.

Option (iii): three nested shapes, each lying inside the next: a large light-green circle (outermost), inside it a yellow-green ellipse (middle), inside that a small teal-green circle (innermost); the shapes are not concentric - each inner shape sits slightly right of and a little below the centre of the next outer one. Labels with dashed arrows: 'Multiples of 32' (left) points to the OUTERMOST circle, 'Multiples of 8' (middle, arrow from the bottom of the yellow-green ellipse) points to the MIDDLE ellipse, 'Multiples of 4' (right, arrow from the innermost circle going down-right) points to the INNERMOST circle. So it shows 4 inside 8 inside 32. Label '(iii)' at the top left.

Option (iv): three nested shapes: a large sky-blue circle (outermost), inside it a light-green ellipse (middle), inside that a small green circle (innermost); not concentric - each inner shape sits slightly right of and a little below the centre of the next outer one.
